author: your-initials
decision: The decision as one question, in the words you used at the time.

options.label: Option the visible context points to

goal: What a good outcome meant to you. Cruxes are judged against this.
visible_context: What you knew at the start. Write it so a reader would lean towards one option.

hidden_facts.text: A fact you learned later that changed (or should have changed) the decision.
hidden_facts.why: Why it flips the decision given the goal.

hidden_facts.text: A fact with the same shape and topic as c1 that does NOT change the decision.

notes: Anything else. Remove names and identifying details.
